normalized_decision: Three distinct parsing strategies: Go uses stdlib go/parser (exact); TypeScript/JavaScript uses regex extractors for import/export/require/dynamic import; Python uses regex for from/import including relative imports; each has dedicated Resolve for module/alias/relative handling
authority_evidence: Implemented in lang.init() registration; each language file has Imports() and Resolve(); README 318-322 acknowledges TS/Python regex approach as not full parsers; README 49-70 documents per-language config
candidate_rule: Go: parser.ParseFile; TS: regex (tsFrom|tsBare|tsRequire|tsDynamic); Py: regex (pyFrom|pyImport); each with language-specific Resolve()
